verdict.rationale: Greenhouse documents a reporting module that builds recruiting reports by candidates, sources, departments, jobs, offices, offers and openings, with filtering and AI report filters. That covers source analysis and per-role and per-team slicing. An Offer Forecast feature tracks roles against target offer acceptances. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of stage-to-stage conversion metrics, time-to-hire reporting, a direct offer-accept-rate metric, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the analytics.
